note: Valid SpecTherm — each program PARSES (thermite-syntax) and the thermite-spec validator must ACCEPT it (no SpecError). Covers all 8 registered combinators in contract positions + a spec-fn call in a contract. cases.name: sorted_in_req
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32]) -> u32 ! pure requires sorted(xs) ensures result == 0 { 0 }

cases.name: forall_in_in_ens
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32], n: u32) -> u32 ! pure requires true ensures forall_in(xs, |x| x != n) { 0 }

cases.name: exists_in_in_ens
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32], n: u32) -> u32 ! pure requires true ensures exists_in(xs, |x| x == n) { 0 }

cases.name: count_where_in_ens
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32]) -> usize ! pure requires true ensures count_where(xs, |x| x == 0) <= xs.len() { 0 }

cases.name: permutation_of_in_req
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32], ys: &[u32]) -> u32 ! pure requires permutation_of(xs, ys) ensures result == 0 { 0 }

cases.name: disjoint_in_req
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32], ys: &[u32]) -> u32 ! pure requires disjoint(xs, ys) ensures result == 0 { 0 }

cases.name: forall_below_in_ens
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32], i: usize) -> u32 ! pure requires true ensures forall_below(xs, i, |x| x < 5) { 0 }

cases.name: forall_from_in_ens
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32], i: usize) -> u32 ! pure requires true ensures forall_from(xs, i, |x| x > 5) { 0 }

cases.name: spec_fn_call_in_ens
cases.program: spec fn sz(xs: &[u32]) -> usize measures xs.len() { xs.len() } fn f(xs: &[u32]) -> usize ! pure requires true ensures result == sz(xs) { 0 }

cases.name: named_spec_fn_in_closure
cases.program: spec fn is_small(x: u32) -> bool measures 0 { x < 10 } fn f(xs: &[u32]) -> u32 ! pure requires true ensures forall_in(xs, |x| is_small(x)) { 0 }
